text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: SEV3 pager triggered — sudden tail-latency spike on /v1/generate (prod-us-east-1). KV cache memory alarm + continuous-batcher backlog. Paging on-call.

Mia Chen: kv-cache resident set jumped on packer-pool nodes (node-20..22). Observed evictions and paging events. Short-shape 95p jumped from ~90ms to ~700ms; long-shape also slower but less % impact.

Samir Patel: tracing shows continuous-batcher forming very large packs dominated by long requests. Short requests are waiting behind pack formation and KV prefetch is creating extra load (page-ins).

Jen Brooks: taking this pager. ETA 4m to triage. @Mia can you paste the current packer and scheduler config + last deploy sha?

Mia Chen: current live config:
```
pack_max: 48
batch_split_threshold_ms: 25
prefetch_enabled: true
kv_cache_target_bytes: 14GB
scheduler_policy: weight_by_shape
```
Deploy SHA: b4f7c3d (rolled ~03:04 UTC)

Leo Gómez: logs show repeated prefetch floods for long inputs, repeated page faults on nodes with high resident sets. Scheduler isn't preempting long packs once they start; short ones queue up.

Arjun Rao: customer note: one Dedicated tenant on prod-us-east-1 saw increased 5xx and timeouts; engineering support alerted account owners. Early estimate: impact window ~03:02-03:38 UTC.

Samir Patel: immediate mitigations to consider (low-risk first):
- decrease pack_max to 8-16 on a canary set of nodes
- temporarily disable prefetch on affected nodes
- enable short-shape prioritization rule when pack_queue_delay > 40ms
Recommend canary two nodes first before rolling.

Jen Brooks: Agreed. Plan: canary node-20/21. Set pack_max=12, prefetch_enabled=false, and push scheduler override to prioritize short shapes. Roll 1st and observe 5m.

Mia Chen: running hotfix now:
```
./ops/hot-config --pool=pack-pool-prod --nodes=node-20,node-21 \
  --set pack_max=12 --set prefetch_enabled=false --tag=hotfix/short-prio-1757
```

Deploy-bot: Config changes applied to node-20,node-21. change-id: cfg-1757-hotfix

Jen Brooks: canary metrics: node-20/21 queue depth down ~60%, short-shape 95p reduced to ~130ms on those nodes. Good signal.

Samir Patel: begin rolling to node-22 next. Leave node-18/19 untouched to preserve capacity for long requests. Also adding a temporary scheduler policy: if queue_delay > 40ms, favor short shapes by weight*2.

Mia Chen: rolling to node-22. Patcher: adding emergency scheduler rule via median-based gating.

Incident Bot: Pager update logged. Severity remains SEV3. Please populate customer-impact notes for postmortem.

Arjun Rao: customer impact summary: approx 1.8% of short realtime requests experienced 95p >500ms; a small subset (0.5%) of requests from 3 enterprise API keys returned 504s during the peak. No data corruption. Affected customers notified.

Leo Gómez: after full roll (node-20..22) metrics back to normal on those nodes. Overall cluster 95p improved but still watching nodes 18/19. Keeping short-priority rule enabled for 30min and then re-evaluate.

Samir Patel: follow-ups: create INF-4872 to add adaptive prefetch backoff (so prefetch throttles when page_fault_rate > threshold), and INF-4873 to refine batch_split_threshold tuning per shape. Also add canary gating to pack_max config changes.

Jen Brooks: Oncall handoff: @Leo you're up for 4h. I'll add a condensed timeline and action items to the incident doc. Please escalate if tail returns.

Leo Gómez: ack. I'll monitor dashboards and draft incident summary and customer comms. Closing active incident when metrics stable for 30m.

Incident Bot: Incident transitioned to monitoring mode pending 30m stability. Incident record id: inc-1757-pack-sched-fairness. Thank you all.
